task: Identify the most downloaded English-Chinese (en-zh) machine translation model on Huggingface and report its latest performance metrics and usage guidelines.
answer: The most downloaded English-Chinese (en-zh) machine translation model on Hugging Face is facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M, with approximately 963k downloads (963,076 downloads last month). It was identified by applying the site's Translation task filter, English + Chinese language filters, and sorting by Most downloads on the Models hub. Latest performance metrics from the model card: evaluated with BLEU, spBLEU, and chrF++ automatic metrics across 200 languages, plus human evaluation using the XSTS protocol and toxicity measurement. Usage guidelines: this is a research model for machine translation among 200 languages; it is intended for single-sentence translation of general-domain text only, with input limited to 512 tokens; it is not for production deployment, document translation, or certified translations; use it via the Fairseq repository (NLLB-200) under the CC-BY-NC license.
